segments.an5.207:1.3: Khuddaṃ [khudaṃ (sī. pī.) khudhāti sakkatānulomaṃ. mahāva.282] paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, āmāvasesaṃ pāceti.
segments.an5.207:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā”ti.

lines: Āmāvasesaṃ pācetīti sace āmāvasesakaṃ hoti, taṃ pāceti.
Aṭṭhame acakkhussanti na cakkhūnaṃ hitaṃ, cakkhuṃ visuddhaṃ na karoti.
